name: @polyspec/crudui-workspace
description: YAML-based form generation and validation system (Multi-language, Multi-framework)

scripts.build: npm run build:validator && npm run build:generators && npm run build:bindings
scripts.build:generators: npm run build -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-core && npm run build -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-html && npm run build -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-react && npm run build -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-vue && npm run build -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-svelte
scripts.docs:prepare: npm run manifest:docs && npm run docs:api && npm run spec:schema
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:prepare && node scripts/docs-web/cli.mjs build
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:prepare && node scripts/docs-web/cli.mjs dev
scripts.docs:preview: npm run docs:prepare && node scripts/docs-web/cli.mjs preview
scripts.docs:check:all: status=0; npm run manifest:check || status=1; npm run manifest:docs:check || status=1; npm run docs:check:documents || status=1; npm run docs:check || status=1; exit $status
scripts.test:forms: node scripts/require-current-build.mjs || exit 1; status=0; node packages/generator-core/scripts/write-tailwind-styles.mjs --check || status=1; npm test -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-core || status=1; npm test -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-html || status=1; npm test -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-react || status=1; npm test -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-vue || status=1; npm test -w @polyspec/crudui-generator-svelte || status=1; npm test -w @polyspec/crudui-form-binding || status=1; node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- tests/fixtures/form-render/normalize.test.mjs tests/form-styles.test.mjs tests/viewport.test.mjs tests/tailwind-styles.test.mjs tests/style-properties.test.mjs tests/form-markup/naming.test.mjs examples/product-forms/examples.test.mjs || status=1; node scripts/run-tests.mjs node --timeout 120 -- tests/widget-script-runs.test.mjs || status=1; exit $status
scripts.test:form-comparison: status=0; npm run test:form-comparison:source || status=1; npm run test:form-comparison:library || status=1; npm run test:form-comparison:browser || status=1; exit $status
scripts.test:form-comparison:source: node scripts/require-current-build.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- examples/form-comparison/browser-report.test.mjs examples/form-comparison/check-*.test.mjs examples/form-comparison/container-runtime.test.mjs examples/form-comparison/public/*.test.mjs examples/form-comparison/src/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:form-comparison:pipeline: node scripts/require-current-build.mjs || exit 1; status=0; node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- examples/form-comparison/record-stores.test.mjs || status=1; node scripts/run-tests.mjs go --cwd examples/form-comparison/servers/go -- ./... || status=1; node scripts/run-tests.mjs cargo -- --locked --manifest-path examples/form-comparison/servers/rust/Cargo.toml || status=1; node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- examples/form-comparison/pipeline.browser.mjs || status=1; exit $status
scripts.test:runtimes: node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- tests/build/runtime-version-policy.test.mjs tests/build/form-comparison-ci.test.mjs tests/build/make-tool-path.test.mjs tests/build/rust-node-entry-points.test.mjs tests/build/conformance-evidence.test.mjs tests/build/unicode-properties.test.mjs tests/build/github-repository.test.mjs tests/build/package-names.test.mjs tests/build/php-extensions.test.mjs tests/build/ci-local.test.mjs tests/build/run-tests.test.mjs tests/build/test-commands.test.mjs tests/build/validator-test-clocks.test.mjs tests/build/contract-manifest.test.mjs tests/build/rust-release-profile.test.mjs tests/build/shared-resources.test.mjs tests/build/holder-lock.test.mjs tests/build/full-run.test.mjs tests/build/push-gate.test.mjs tests/build/make-dry-run.test.mjs tests/build/checkout-npm.test.mjs tests/build/atomic-publish.test.mjs tests/build/failure-messages.test.mjs tests/build/owner-check.test.mjs tests/build/install-browsers.test.mjs tests/build/tracked-files.test.mjs tests/build/offline-checks.test.mjs tests/build/target-report.test.mjs tests/build/install-lock.test.mjs tests/build/ci-passed.test.mjs tests/build/release.test.mjs
scripts.test:build: node scripts/require-current-build.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- tests/build/public-packages.test.mjs tests/build/vite-config.test.mjs tests/build/ci-browser.test.mjs tests/build/package-install-pack.test.mjs tests/build/lint-coverage.test.mjs tests/build/run-command.test.mjs tests/build/hooks.test.mjs
scripts.test:bench: node scripts/require-current-build.mjs && node tools/bench/build-drivers.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- tests/build/bench-drivers.test.mjs
scripts.test:build:repeat: status=0; node scripts/repeat-build.mjs || status=1; node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- tests/build/reproducible-build.test.mjs || status=1; exit $status
